title: Online Banking Fraud SOP
description: Standard operating procedure for investigating online banking fraud, phishing, and unauthorized money transfers.
steps: Obtain the transaction details, including transaction ID, timestamp, and target account/UPI.
Send an immediate freeze request to the beneficiary bank or payment gateway using the official nodal email.
Request IPDR logs from the payment gateway to track the IP address used for the transaction.
Submit a domain takedown request if spoofed/phishing banking sites were identified.
Draft and issue a legal request under Section 91 CrPC (or equivalent local laws) to collect KYC documents.
resources: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (NCRP) Nodal Contact List
Draft Nodal Email Template for Bank Freeze

title: Investment & Crypto Scam SOP
description: Workflow for tracking high-yield investment scams, part-time task frauds, and cryptocurrency money laundering.
steps: Identify the destination crypto wallet address and trace it using blockchain explorer tools (e.g., Etherscan, Tronscan).
Request transaction details and KYC documents from the relevant crypto exchanges where the wallets are registered.
Submit takedown requests for the fraudulent investment portal domain.
Liaise with Telegram support to block the promoter usernames/channels.
Track the beneficiary bank accounts associated with any intermediate fiat conversions.
legal_provisions: Section 102 CrPC (Power of police officer to seize certain property)

title: Loan App Extortion SOP
description: Procedures for mitigating harassment and extortion from illegal short-term lending mobile applications.
steps: Identify the rogue application package name and download URL.
Report the application to Google Play Store / Apple App Store for violation of developer policies.
Analyze the application's C2 server IP address and trace its hosting provider.
Trace the beneficiary UPI handles and bank accounts used to receive loan repayments.
Advise the victim to uninstall the app, secure their device, and notify their contacts about the fraud.
resources: Google Play Console Abusive App Report Form
Leaked Loan App C2 Servers Database

title: Impersonation & Courier Scam SOP
description: Guide on investigating parcel-related frauds and impersonation of police or customs officers.
steps: Identify the phone numbers and WhatsApp/Telegram accounts used by the fake officers.
Request Call Detail Records (CDR) and cell tower locations for the suspect phone numbers.
Submit official requests to the logistics company to verify the tracking number.
Track target accounts where the victim transferred money under fear of arrest.
Coordinate with local cyber cells to map caller location hotspots (e.g., Mewat, Jamtara).

title: KYC Update / SIM Swap SOP
description: Standard operating procedure for investigating SIM swap frauds and update-impersonation scams.
steps: Verify with the telecom operator if a SIM swap or duplicate SIM card issuance occurred.
Request the Customer Acquisition Form (CAF) and KYC documents submitted for the swapped SIM card.
Freeze the beneficiary e-wallets or bank accounts linked to the fraudulent transactions.
Submit takedown requests for spoofed KYC update portals.
Trace the location and device details used for SIM registration.
resources: Jio/Airtel Nodal Officer CAF Request Form

title: Digital Evidence Preservation Standard
description: General standards for seizing, acquiring, and preserving digital evidence in cybercrime investigations.
steps: Document the state of the device (On/Off) before touching it.
Use write-blockers when performing forensic acquisition of storage drives.
Calculate SHA256/MD5 hashes of the acquired forensic images immediately.
Label and store evidence in anti-static bags with a complete Chain of Custody log.
Avoid logging in to online profiles on suspect devices without proper network isolation.
legal_provisions: Section 65B Indian Evidence Act (Admissibility of electronic records)
resources: Chain of Custody Standard Form Template
